# Jack Hwang's Martial Arts

Jack Hwang's Martial Arts is a martial arts school in Oklahoma City, OK offering Kids Martial Arts, Taekwondo, Black Belt Class for kids, teens, and adults.

## About
Jack Hwang's Martial Arts has been training Oklahoma City students since 1964 — over 60 years of authentic Taekwondo instruction passed down through Grand Master Hwang's legendary lineage.

## Programs
- Kids Martial Arts
- Taekwondo
- Black Belt Class

## Location

Oklahoma City, OK 73159
